claims.statement: The Basilisco chilote originates from Chilota mythology in the southern region of Chile.
claims.statement_id: Basilisco chilote berasal dari tradisi mitologi Chiloé di wilayah selatan Chile.
claims.quote: The Basilisco chilote is a creature from Chilota mythology originating from the Chiloé Archipelago, in southern Chile.

claims.statement: The creature has the crest of a rooster and a serpent body.
claims.statement_id: Basilisco chilote digambarkan memiliki jengger ayam jantan dan tubuh seekor ular.
claims.quote: The Basilisco chilote is described as having the crest of a rooster and the body of a serpent.

claims.statement: It feeds on saliva and phlegm, causing victims to dehydrate and perish.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini mengisap air liur dan dahak penghuni rumah sampai mereka mati dehidrasi.
claims.quote: It feeds on the phlegm and saliva of the people who live in the house, causing the inhabitants to dehydrate and eventually die.

claims.statement: Basilisco, fasilisco, culebrón and athrathrao are names for a creature of Chilota mythology that is half rooster and half snake.
claims.statement_id: Basilisco, fasilisco, culebrón, athrathrao adalah nama-nama makhluk mitologi Chiloé yang setengah ayam jantan dan setengah ular.
claims.quote: El basilisco, fasilisco, culebrón o athrathrao de la mitología chilota es una criatura mitad gallo y mitad culebra.

claims.statement: Its origin may be a union of the Basilisk myth of Greek mythology and the Colo Colo of Mapuche mythology.
claims.statement_id: Asalnya mungkin berupa gabungan mitos Basilisk dari mitologi Yunani dan Colo Colo dari mitologi Mapuche.
claims.quote: Posiblemente su origen se deba a la unión del mito del Basilisco de la mitología griega, y del Colo Colo de la mitología mapuche.

claims.statement: It has a rooster's head with a red crest and a long neck like a snake's body; its body is like a rooster's but with small wings and legs, so it can only move by crawling along the ground.
claims.statement_id: Ia berkepala ayam jantan dengan jengger merah dan berleher panjang seperti tubuh ular; tubuhnya seperti ayam jantan tetapi bersayap dan berkaki kecil sehingga hanya dapat bergerak dengan merayap di tanah.
claims.quote: tiene cabeza de gallo con una cresta roja, y un cuello largo como el cuerpo de una serpiente. Su cuerpo es igual al del gallo pero con pequeñas alas y patas, por eso sólo puede moverse arrastrándose por el suelo.

claims.statement: It is born in a henhouse from a small, round, thick-shelled, grayish-white egg called the huevo lloilloy or huevo lloe, which legend holds was laid and incubated by a rooster.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, ia lahir di kandang ayam dari telur kecil bulat bercangkang tebal dan kasar, berwarna putih keabu-abuan, yang disebut huevo lloilloy atau huevo lloe dan dipercaya dierami oleh seekor ayam jantan.
claims.quote: Nace en un gallinero, de un pequeño huevo redondo de cáscara gruesa y rugosa (aproximadamente de un centímetro de diámetro), de color blanco grisáceo, llamado huevo lloilloy o huevo lloe, el cual según la leyenda se cree que sería puesto e incubado por un gallo.

claims.statement: By day the Basilisco chilote hides beneath the house of the henhouse's owner, and at night it comes out of its hiding place while everyone sleeps.
claims.statement_id: Pada siang hari basilisco chilote bersembunyi di bawah rumah pemilik kandang ayam, dan pada malam hari keluar dari persembunyiannya saat semua orang tidur.
claims.quote: En el día, el basilisco chilote se oculta debajo de la casa del dueño del gallinero, y en la noche saldría de su escondite mientras todas las personas duermen.

claims.statement: At that moment it would emit a hypnotic song like a rooster's crow, which keeps people asleep.
claims.statement_id: Saat itu ia mengeluarkan nyanyian menghipnotis yang mirip kokok ayam jantan sehingga orang-orang tetap tertidur.
claims.quote: En ese momento emitiría un canto hipnótico similar al canto del gallo, que provocaría que las personas se mantengan dormidas.

claims.statement: To kill it, the egg must be burned as soon as it is laid and the chicken that laid it killed; once hatched, the only way to destroy it is to burn down the house where it lives.
claims.statement_id: Untuk membunuhnya, telur harus dibakar segera setelah dikeluarkan dan ayam yang bertelur harus dibunuh; setelah menetas, satu-satunya cara memusnahkannya adalah membakar rumah tempat ia tinggal.
claims.quote: To kill Basilisco chilote, you must burn the egg as soon as it is laid and kill the chicken that laid it, to prevent further eggs from being laid. Once hatched the only way to destroy it is by burning down the house where it lives.

claims.statement: It hatches from an egg incubated by a rooster and lives in a hole it digs under a house.
claims.statement_id: Ia menetas dari telur yang dierami seekor ayam jantan dan tinggal di lubang yang digalinya di bawah sebuah rumah.
claims.quote: It is hatched from an egg that is incubated by a rooster and lives in a hole which it digs under a house.

claims.statement: The Burrokeet is a donkey-man character traditionally staged in Trinidad and Tobago Carnival.
claims.statement_id: Burrokeet adalah karakter manusia-keledai tradisional di karnaval Trinidad dan Tobago.
claims.quote: The Burrokeet (alternative spellings: Burroquite, borokit, borokite, bourriquite) is a "donkey-man" character traditionally portrayed in Trinidad and Tobago Carnival.

claims.statement: Derived from burroquito, the costume gives the illusion of a dancer mounted on a donkey.
claims.statement_id: Namanya diturunkan dari kata Spanyol burroquito, dengan kostum berilusi penari menunggang keledai.
claims.quote: The name derives from the Spanish word burroquito (little donkey), the character's costume being constructed so as to give the illusion of a dancer riding a small burro or donkey.

claims.statement: Venezuelan settlers introduced this masquerade performance into Trinidad.
claims.statement_id: Karakter topeng ini diperkenalkan ke Trinidad oleh para pemukim Venezuela.
claims.quote: This masquerade was brought to Trinidad by Venezuelan settlers.

claims.statement: The costume is a well-decorated donkey's head of coloured paper on a bamboo frame; the masquerader enters through a hole at the back of the "donkey"'s neck, holds the reins, and wears the animal's body around his hips, creating the illusion of being its rider.
claims.statement_id: Kostumnya berupa kepala keledai berhias dari kertas berwarna pada rangka bambu; penari masuk lewat lubang di belakang leher "keledai", memegang tali kekang, dengan tubuh keledai terpasang di pinggulnya sehingga tampak seperti penunggangnya.
claims.quote: The burrokeet costume is a well-decorated donkey's head made from coloured paper and attached to a bamboo frame. The masquerader enters through a hole at the back of the "donkey"'s neck and carries the reins in his hands, with the animal's body fitted around his hips, thereby creating the illusion of being the donkey's rider.

claims.statement: The donkey's body is covered in a long satin skirt and has a sisal rope tail, sometimes decorated with flowers; the bit and bridle are of coloured cord.
claims.statement_id: Tubuh keledai ditutup rok satin panjang dan berekor tali sisal yang kadang dihiasi bunga; kekang dan tali kepalanya dibuat dari tali berwarna.
claims.quote: The donkey's body is covered in a long satin skirt and has a sisal rope tail, sometimes decorated with flowers. The bit and bridle are made of coloured cord.

claims.statement: The "rider" wears a satin shirt and a large matador straw hat and dances in a way that mimics the antics of a donkey, making it caper and bow.
claims.statement_id: "Penunggang" mengenakan kemeja satin dan topi jerami matador besar, lalu menari menirukan tingkah keledai yang melonjak dan membungkuk.
claims.quote: The "rider" wears a satin shirt and a large matador straw hat and dances in a way that mimics the antics of a donkey, making it caper and bow.

claims.statement: A dance called Burriquite with origins in Venezuela is also performed.
claims.statement_id: Tarian bernama Burriquite yang berasal dari Venezuela juga dibawakan.
claims.quote: A dance called Burriquite with origins in Venezuela is also performed.

claims.statement: The burrokeet masquerade, associated with the South American mainland and Venezuelan Spaniards, has become linked with the "Sou-Marie" character derived from East Indian culture brought to Trinidad by indentured labourers.
claims.statement_id: Mas burrokeet, yang dikaitkan dengan daratan Amerika Selatan dan orang Spanyol Venezuela, telah terkait dengan tokoh "Sou-Marie" yang berasal dari budaya India Timur yang dibawa buruh kontrak ke Trinidad.
claims.quote: The burrokeet masquerade, associated with the South American mainland and Venezuelan Spaniards, has become linked with the "Sou-Marie" character that derives from East Indian culture brought to Trinidad by indentured labourers.

claims.statement: The National Carnival Commission says the Burrokeet, named from the Spanish word burroquito (little donkey), is designed to look like a dancer riding a donkey, with a decorated donkey's head typically made from coloured paper.
claims.statement_id: National Carnival Commission menyebut Burrokeet, yang namanya berasal dari kata Spanyol burroquito (keledai kecil), dirancang agar tampak seperti penari menunggang keledai, dengan kepala keledai berhias yang umumnya dari kertas berwarna.
claims.quote: The Burrokeet, which originated from the Spanish word burroquito (little donkey), is designed to look like a dancer riding a donkey. The costume comprises a decorated donkey's head typically made from coloured paper.

claims.statement: Sometimes the Burrokeet performer stages a dance called Burriquite, which originated in Venezuela.
claims.statement_id: Kadang-kadang penampil Burrokeet membawakan tarian bernama Burriquite yang berasal dari Venezuela.
claims.quote: Sometimes, the Burrokeet performer will stage a dance called Burriquite, which originated in Venezuela.

claims.statement: The cactus cat is a legendary creature of the American Southwest.
claims.statement_id: Kucing kaktus adalah makhluk legendaris fearsome critter dari wilayah American Southwest.
claims.quote: The cactus cat is a legendary "fearsome critter" of the American Southwest.

claims.statement: It resembles a bobcat covered in thorns with long spiny legs and an armored branched tail.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini bertubuh mirip bobcat yang tertutup duri, dengan kaki berduri panjang dan ekor lapis baja bercabang.
claims.quote: The cactus cat was generally described being a bobcat-like creature, covered in hair-like thorns, with particularly long spines extending from the legs and its armored, branching tail.

claims.statement: The creature used its sharp spines to puncture cacti at night for plant juice.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini konon menyayat kaktus di malam hari agar cairannya keluar mengalir.
claims.quote: The creature was said to use its spines to slash cacti at night, allowing juice to run from the plants.

claims.statement: According to Cox, the cactus cat, as its name signifies, lives in the great cactus districts and is particularly abundant between Prescott and Tucson.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Cox, kucing kaktus, seperti namanya, hidup di daerah-daerah kaktus yang luas dan terutama banyak di antara Prescott dan Tucson.
claims.quote: The cactus cat, as its name signifies, lives in the great cactus districts, and is particularly abundant between Prescott and Tucson.

claims.statement: It has also been reported from the valley of the lower Yaqui in Old Mexico and the cholla-covered hills of Yucatan.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini juga dilaporkan dari lembah Yaqui bagian bawah di Meksiko Lama dan perbukitan Yucatan yang dipenuhi cholla.
claims.quote: It has been reported, also, from the valley of the lower Yaqui, in Old Mexico, and the cholla-covered hills of Yucatan.

claims.statement: The cactus cat has thorny hair, with especially long, rigid thorns on its ears; its tail is branched, and on the forearms above its front feet are sharp, knifelike blades of bone.
claims.statement_id: Kucing kaktus berambut berduri, duri pada telinganya sangat panjang dan kaku; ekornya bercabang, dan pada lengan bawah di atas kaki depannya terdapat bilah tulang tajam seperti pisau.
claims.quote: The cactus cat has thorny hair, the thorns being especially long and rigid on its ears. Its tail is branched, and upon the forearms above its front feet are sharp, knifelike blades of bone.

claims.statement: With these blades it slashes the base of giant cactus trees so that the sap exudes, doing this systematically to many trees over several nights as it makes a big circuit.
claims.statement_id: Dengan bilah itu ia menyayat pangkal pohon kaktus raksasa sehingga getahnya keluar; ini dilakukan secara sistematis pada banyak pohon selama beberapa malam saat ia berkeliling dalam lingkaran besar.
claims.quote: With these blades it slashes the base of giant cactus trees, causing the sap to exude. This is done systematically, many trees being slashed in the course of several nights as the cat makes a big circuit.

claims.statement: By the time it returns to its starting place the first cactus's sap has fermented into a sweet, very intoxicating kind of mescal; the thirsty beast laps it up greedily, soon becomes fiddling drunk, and waltzes off in the moonlight rasping its bony forearms together and screaming with delight.
claims.statement_id: Ketika ia kembali ke titik awal, getah kaktus pertama telah berfermentasi menjadi sejenis mescal yang manis dan sangat memabukkan; makhluk yang haus itu menjilatnya dengan rakus, segera mabuk berat, lalu berjalan berdansa di bawah cahaya bulan sambil menggesekkan lengan bawahnya yang bertulang dan menjerit kegirangan.
claims.quote: By the time it is back to the place of beginning the sap of the first cactus has fermented into a kind of mescal, sweet and very intoxicating. This is greedily lapped up by the thirsty beast, which soon becomes fiddling drunk, and goes waltzing off in the moonlight, rasping its bony forearms across each other and screaming with delight.

claims.statement: According to Cox, only the old-timers know of the beast and its queer habits.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Cox, hanya para penghuni lama yang mengetahui hewan ini dan kebiasaannya yang aneh.
claims.quote: Only the old-timers know of the beast and its queer habits.

claims.statement: Cox writes that nearly every lumber district has mysterious stories or vague rumors of dreadful beasts with which to regale newcomers and frighten people unfamiliar with the woods.
claims.statement_id: Cox menulis bahwa hampir setiap daerah penebangan kayu punya cerita misterius atau kabar samar tentang binatang menakutkan untuk menghibur pendatang baru dan menakuti orang yang tak mengenal hutan.
claims.quote: Some have their songs also, and nearly all have mysterious stories or vague rumors of dreadful beasts with which to regale newcomers and frighten people unfamiliar with the woods.

claims.statement: Cox states his purpose is to preserve at least a description and sketch of some of the interesting animals the lumberjacks originated.
claims.statement_id: Cox menyatakan tujuan bukunya adalah melestarikan setidaknya deskripsi dan sketsa sebagian hewan menarik yang diciptakan oleh para penebang kayu.
claims.quote: It is my purpose in this little book to preserve at least a description and sketch of some of the interesting animals which he has originated.

claims.statement: The Cahuelche or Cahuella is a magical aquatic creature in Chilota mythology.
claims.statement_id: Cahuelche atau Cahuella adalah makhluk gaib akuatik dalam mitologi Chiloé.
claims.quote: El Cahuelche (del mapudungun kawel: «delfín» y che: «persona»), también llamado Cahuella, es una criatura mágica acuática presente en la mitología chilota.

claims.statement: It possesses an appearance virtually identical to the tonina dolphin.
claims.statement_id: Wujud fisiknya serupa atau identik dengan lumba-lumba tonina (Cephalorhynchus eutropia).
claims.quote: Se dice que es un bello animal, con apariencia muy similar, o idéntica, a la especie de cetáceo llamado delfín chileno o tonina (Cephalorhynchus eutropia), por lo que a simple vista no se podría diferenciar del mismo.

claims.statement: It was granted high intelligence and a magical cry to communicate with human beings.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini dipulihkan kecerdasannya dan memiliki pekikan magis untuk berkomunikasi dengan manusia.
claims.quote: le habría devuelto su inteligencia y dado un mágico chillido para comunicarse con los humanos nuevamente.

claims.statement: According to the legend, it was originally human and was transformed by magic into what it now is.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, asalnya manusia yang diubah menjadi wujudnya sekarang dengan sihir.
claims.quote: Su origen habría sido humano; pero habría sido transformado en lo que ahora sería por arte de magia.

claims.statement: Its transformation happened during the mythic struggle between Tenten Vilu and Caicai Vilu, when it was one of the humans drowning in the great flood and was saved by Tenten by being turned into a magical tonina.
claims.statement_id: Perubahannya terjadi pada masa pertarungan mitis antara Tenten Vilu dan Caicai Vilu: ia salah satu manusia yang tenggelam dalam banjir besar dan diselamatkan Tenten dengan diubah menjadi tonina ajaib.
claims.quote: Su transformación habría ocurrido en los tiempos de la lucha mítica entre Tenten Vilu Y Caicai Vilu, siendo uno de los humanos que se ahogaban en la gran inundación y que fue salvado por Tenten al ser transformado en una mágica tonina.

claims.statement: The Cahuelche is much more intelligent than animals of that species, and the sound it emits is different, carrying a meaning that is magically understandable to humans.
claims.statement_id: Cahuelche jauh lebih cerdas daripada hewan sejenisnya, dan suara yang dikeluarkannya berbeda serta bermakna yang secara ajaib dapat dipahami manusia.
claims.quote: el Cahuelche no solamente sería mucho más inteligente que los animales de esta especie sino que el sonido que emitiría sería distinto, presentando un significado que sería mágicamente comprensible para los seres humanos.

claims.statement: From that day the Cahuelche accompanies the Huenchur and acts as both her helper and secretary before humans, since the Huenchur is not permitted to communicate directly with any human being.
claims.statement_id: Sejak hari itu Cahuelche menemani Huenchur dan bertindak sebagai pembantu sekaligus sekretarisnya di hadapan manusia, karena Huenchur tidak diizinkan berkomunikasi langsung dengan manusia mana pun.
claims.quote: Desde ese día, el Cahuelche acompañaría a la Huenchur y actuaría tanto como su ayudante como su secretario frente a los humanos - ya que a la Huenchur no se le está permitido comunicarse directamente con ningún ser humano.

claims.statement: When the Huenchur wants to communicate changes in the weather or the nearby presence of the ghost ship "El Caleuche", she orders the Cahuelche to make great leaps over the sea surface.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Huenchur ingin menyampaikan perubahan cuaca atau kedekatan kapal hantu "El Caleuche", ia menyuruh Cahuelche melompat tinggi di permukaan laut.
claims.quote: Así, cuando la Huenchur desea comunicar cambios en el clima o la presencia cercana del barco fantasma "El Caleuche", ordenaría al Cahuelche dar grandes saltos sobre la superficie del mar

claims.statement: If the Huenchur wants to announce the approaching death of one of the inhabitants living by the sea, she sends the Cahuelche to the shore, very near the house of the person about to die.
claims.statement_id: Bila Huenchur ingin mengumumkan kematian seorang penghuni tepi laut, ia mengirim Cahuelche ke tepi pantai, dekat rumah orang yang akan meninggal.
claims.quote: En el caso de que la Huenchur desee anunciar que se producirá una próxima muerte de alguno de los habitantes que vive a la orilla del mar, enviaría al Cahuelche a la orilla de la playa, muy cerca de la casa del próximo difunto.

claims.statement: Millalobo gave the Huenchur the power to communicate with the inhabitants of the land through the wind and by means of a helper called the Cahuelche.
claims.statement_id: Millalobo memberi Huenchur kekuatan untuk berkomunikasi dengan penghuni daratan melalui angin dan lewat seorang pembantu bernama Cahuelche.
claims.quote: le dio el poder para comunicarse con los habitantes de la tierra, a través del viento y por medio de un ayudante, llamado el Cahuelche.

claims.statement: Millalobo, sensing the sorrow of this tonina and also wishing to give help and company to the Huenchur, decided to help them both.
claims.statement_id: Millalobo, yang merasakan kepedihan tonina itu dan ingin membantu serta menemani Huenchur, memutuskan menolong keduanya.
claims.quote: El gran Millalobo, sintiendo la amargura de esta tonina, y como igualmente deseaba darle ayuda y compañía a la Huenchur, decidió ayudar a ambos.

claims.statement: In Selknam mythology, Chashkel was an anthropophagous giant.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Selknam, Chashkel adalah raksasa pemakan manusia.
claims.quote: En la mitología selknam, Chashkel, Cháskilts o Čáskels era un gigante antropófago.

claims.statement: The arch-rival of Kwányip, he was defeated while saving the hero's nephews.
claims.statement_id: Menjadi musuh bebuyutan pahlawan Kwányip dan dikalahkan saat menyelamatkan keponakannya.
claims.quote: Adversario por excelencia de Kwányip, fue derrotado por este al salvar a sus sobrinos, los hermanos Sasán.

claims.statement: Chashkel inhabited the banks along the Mac Lelan river.
claims.statement_id: Chashkel berdiam di sepanjang tepi sungai Mac Lelan di Tierra del Fuego.
claims.quote: Chashkel vivía a orillas del río Mac Lelan

claims.statement: He was feared by his contemporaries because of his enormous power.
claims.statement_id: Ia ditakuti orang-orang sezamannya karena kekuatannya yang sangat besar.
claims.quote: Era temido por sus contemporáneos debido a su enorme poder.

claims.statement: Chashkel lived on the banks of the Mac Lelan (or McCLellan) river, which flows into Bahía Inútil in Tierra del Fuego province (Chile), Magallanes and Chilean Antarctica Region, in the area of Villa Cameron, capital of the Timaukel commune.
claims.statement_id: Chashkel tinggal di tepi sungai Mac Lelan (atau McCLellan), yang bermuara di Bahía Inútil, provinsi Tierra del Fuego (Chile), Región de Magallanes dan Antártica Chilena, di kawasan Villa Cameron, ibu kota komune Timaukel.
claims.quote: Chashkel vivía a orillas del río Mac Lelan (o McCLellan), que desemboca en la bahía Inútil, provincia de Tierra del Fuego (chile), Región de Magallanes y de la Antártica Chilena, en la zona de Villa Cameron, capital de la comuna de Timaukel.

claims.statement: It is said that many scattered bones of the people the giant devoured can still be found at that place today.
claims.statement_id: Konon di tempat itu kini masih dapat ditemukan banyak tulang berserakan milik orang-orang yang dimakan sang raksasa.
claims.quote: Se dice que actualmente en aquel lugar es posible encontrar muchos huesos dispersos, de las personas que el gigante devoraba.

claims.statement: Chashkel had several dogs he specially trained to hunt and kill people; the dogs devoured their prey or brought it to the giant's hut.
claims.statement_id: Chashkel memiliki beberapa anjing yang ia latih khusus untuk memburu dan membunuh manusia; anjing-anjing itu memakan mangsanya atau membawanya ke gubuk sang raksasa.
claims.quote: Chashkel tenía varios perros a los cuales adiestraba especialmente para perseguir y matar personas. Estos perros devoraban a sus presas, o bien las llevaban a la choza del gigante.

claims.statement: According to the myth, Chashkel kidnapped the Sasán brothers, Kwányip's nephews, and kept them as slaves in his hut, where he forced them to gut and clean the entrails of the human corpses he brought.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, Chashkel menculik saudara-saudara Sasán, keponakan Kwányip, dan menahan mereka sebagai budak di gubuknya, memaksa mereka membuang dan membersihkan isi perut mayat manusia yang ia bawa.
claims.quote: Según cuenta el mito, Chashkel secuestró a los hermanos Sasán, sobrinos de Kwányip, y los mantuvo como esclavos en su choza, donde les obligaba a destripar y limpiar las entrañas de los cadáveres humanos que llevaba.

claims.statement: Kwányip set a trap, catching Chashkel in a mire and then freezing him; once Chashkel was exhausted from escaping the trap, Kwányip took the chance to break his spine.
claims.statement_id: Kwányip memasang jebakan, menjebak Chashkel di rawa lumpur lalu membekukannya; setelah Chashkel kelelahan lolos dari jebakan, Kwányip memanfaatkan kesempatan itu untuk mematahkan tulang punggungnya.
claims.quote: Kwányip le tendió una trampa, atrapándolo en un lodazal y posteriormente congelándolo. Chashkel quedó fatigado al escapar de la trampa y luego Kwányip aprovechó la oportunidad para fracturar su columna.

claims.statement: The Sasán brothers came out of hiding and, each with a sling, shot at the giant's eyes; once destroyed, flies were born from them.
claims.statement_id: Saudara-saudara Sasán keluar dari persembunyian dan, masing-masing dengan ketapel, menembak mata sang raksasa; setelah mata itu hancur, lahirlah lalat-lalat darinya.
claims.quote: Los hermanos Sasán salieron de su escondite y, cada uno con una honda, dispararon a los ojos del gigante, de los cuales, una vez destruidos, nacieron moscas.

claims.statement: Memoria Chilena states that Kwanyip, another very powerful shaman who distributed day and night, killed the giant Cháskels and brought death to the world.
claims.statement_id: Memoria Chilena menyebut Kwanyip, dukun yang sangat kuat yang membagi siang dan malam, membunuh raksasa Cháskels dan membawa kematian ke dunia.
claims.quote: Kwanyip, otro chamán muy poderoso que distribuyó el día y la noche, mató al gigante Cháskels y trajo la muerte al mundo

claims.statement: The Chuzalongo is a creature in Ecuadorian mythology inhabiting Andean crags.
claims.statement_id: Chuzalongo adalah makhluk gaib dalam mitologi Ekuador yang menghuni tebing bebatuan Andes.
claims.quote: El chuzalongo o chuhuajinu, chiro o indio del monte es una criatura fantástica de la mitología del Ecuador, habitante de las peñas de los Andes.

claims.statement: One version traces its descent from urcu-yaya and urcu-mama, the mountain spirits.
claims.statement_id: Satu versi menyebutkan ia sebagai keturunan dari urcu-yaya dan urcu-mama, yakni roh gunung.
claims.quote: una versión indica que podría ser hijo del urcu-yaya y la urcu-mama, esto es, hijos del cerro.

claims.statement: It is consistently described as a humanoid being, small as a six-year-old child.
claims.statement_id: Selalu digambarkan berwujud humanoid kerdil seukuran anak berusia enam tahun.
claims.quote: siempre es descrito como un ser de rasgos humanoides, pequeño como un niño de 6 años

claims.statement: Another, more earthly version says it could be the fruit of an incestuous relationship between parents and children or between siblings.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain yang lebih duniawi menyebut ia mungkin buah hubungan inses antara orang tua dan anak atau antarsaudara.
claims.quote: Otra versión más terrenal indica que podría ser el fruto de una relación incestuosa entre padres e hijos o entre hermanos.

claims.statement: Other versions suggest the myth arose in the time of the Spanish conquistadors and was also used by the criollos to evade responsibility for the offspring of their relations with Amerindian women, since the chuzalongo is described as blond and light-eyed.
claims.statement_id: Ada pula versi yang menyebut mitos chuzalongo berasal dari masa para penakluk Spanyol dan dimanfaatkan juga oleh kaum criollo untuk menghindari tanggung jawab atas keturunan hasil hubungan mereka dengan perempuan Amerindian, karena chuzalongo digambarkan berambut pirang dan bermata biru muda.
claims.quote: También hay versiones que indicarían que el mito del chuzalongo se habría originado en tiempo de los conquistadores españoles, y aprovechado también por los criollos, para eludir responsabilidades sobre la descendencia fruto de las relaciones entre estos y las amerindias, ya que el chuzalongo es descrito como un ser rubio y de ojos celestes.

claims.statement: It is always described as a being with humanoid features, small as a 6-year-old child, with long hair that may be blond, white skin and light-blue eyes.
claims.statement_id: Ia selalu digambarkan sebagai makhluk berciri mirip manusia, sekecil anak berusia 6 tahun, berambut panjang yang bisa pirang, berkulit putih, dan bermata biru muda.
claims.quote: siempre es descrito como un ser de rasgos humanoides, pequeño como un niño de 6 años, y de larga cabellera, que puede ser rubia, y de tez blanca y ojos celestes.

claims.statement: Some versions describe it with its feet turned backwards, which would help it elude its pursuers.
claims.statement_id: Ada versi yang menggambarkannya dengan kaki terbalik ke belakang, yang membantunya mengelabui para pengejarnya.
claims.quote: Hay versiones que lo describen con sus pies vueltos hacia atrás, lo cual le serviría para burlar a sus perseguidores.

claims.statement: It is very similar to the duende Tin-Tin, who is its coastal version in Ecuadorian folk legends.
claims.statement_id: Chuzalongo sangat mirip dengan duende Tin-Tin, yang merupakan versi pesisirnya dalam cerita rakyat Ecuador.
claims.quote: Es muy similar al duende Tin-Tin quien es su versión costeña en el folclore de leyendas ecuatorianas.

claims.statement: The chuzalongo is described as having an unbridled sexual appetite that leads it to boldly seduce or rape women it finds alone, and whom it afterwards usually kills.
claims.statement_id: Chuzalongo digambarkan memiliki nafsu seksual tak terkendali yang mendorongnya merayu secara berani atau memperkosa perempuan yang ia temui sendirian, dan kemudian biasanya membunuh mereka.
claims.quote: El chuzalongo cuenta con un desenfrenado apetito sexual que lo lleva seducir audazmente o violar a las mujeres que encuentra solas y a las cuales, posteriormente, suele asesinar.

claims.statement: It is also said to feed on people's blood, although not all versions agree on this.
claims.statement_id: Konon ia juga memakan darah manusia, meskipun tidak semua versi sependapat dalam hal ini.
claims.quote: Se dice que también se alimentaría de la sangre de las personas, aunque no todas las versiones son coincidentes en este aspecto.

claims.statement: It is considered not to be ill-tempered, but if irritated it can kill people with a blow of wind.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap tidak berwatak pemarah, tetapi bila terganggu ia dapat membunuh orang dengan satu embusan angin.
claims.quote: Se le considera que no es un ser malhumorado, aunque, en caso de irritarse, puede llegar a asesinar a las personas con un golpe de viento.

claims.statement: An independent report says its physical description, though variable, likens it to a "duende one metre tall".
claims.statement_id: Sebuah laporan independen menyatakan bahwa rupa fisiknya, meski bervariasi, menyerupai "duende setinggi satu meter".
claims.quote: Su descripción física, aunque variable, lo asimila a un "duende de un metro de altura"

claims.statement: According to the report, cultural promoters in the area distinguish the playful, amorous duende from the Chuzalongo of Imbabura, whom they call "a bit of a satyr" and of clearly indigenous characteristics.
claims.statement_id: Menurut laporan itu, para promotor budaya di Carchi membedakan duende yang suka bermain dan jatuh cinta dari Chuzalongo de Imbabura, yang mereka sebut "agak satir" dan berciri jelas pribumi.
claims.quote: Los promotores culturales de la zona diferencian explícitamente a este ser, juguetón y enamoradizo, de otras figuras mitológicas ecuatorianas como el Chuzalongo de Imbabura, al que califican de "un tanto sátiro" y de claras características indígenas

claims.statement: An independent report states that the legend's declared social function is that of a moral fable and an explicit warning addressed to "young women who must preserve their virginity".
claims.statement_id: Sebuah laporan independen menyebut fungsi sosial legenda ini sebagai fabel moral dan peringatan eksplisit yang ditujukan kepada "perempuan muda yang harus menjaga keperawanan".
claims.quote: La función social declarada de esta leyenda es la de una fábula moral. Es una advertencia explícita: "las jóvenes mujeres que deben preservar su virginidad" son las destinatarias del mensaje

claims.statement: Cuca is one of the main mythological entities in Brazilian folklore.
claims.statement_id: Cuca adalah salah satu makhluk mitologi utama dalam cerita rakyat Brasil.
claims.quote: Cuca é um dos principais seres mitológicos do folclore brasileiro.

claims.statement: She takes the form of an old witch with alligator appearance who may be over 3,000 years old.
claims.statement_id: Ia berwujud penyihir tua berwajah jacaré yang dapat berusia lebih dari tiga ribu tahun.
claims.quote: assume a forma de bruxa velha com aspecto de jacaré, que não se sabe ao certo sua idade mas que pode ter mais de 3 mil anos

claims.statement: In Brazil, Cuca was popularized by Monteiro Lobato's 1921 work O Saci.
claims.statement_id: Sosok Cuca dipopulerkan di Brasil lewat buku O Saci terbitan 1921 oleh Monteiro Lobato.
claims.quote: Au Brésil, la Cuca a été popularisée par le livre "O Saci" (1921), de Monteiro Lobato.

claims.statement: According to Luís da Câmara Cascudo in "Geografia dos Mitos Brasileiros", the Cuca is a myth of Portuguese origin related to the Coca, a figure who appeared in processions in the province of Minho, Portugal.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Luís da Câmara Cascudo dalam "Geografia dos Mitos Brasileiros", Cuca adalah mitos asal Portugis yang terkait dengan Coca, tokoh yang muncul dalam prosesi di provinsi Minho, Portugal.
claims.quote: Em seu livro "Geografia dos Mitos Brasileiros", Luís da Câmara Cascudo (1898-1986) diz que a Cuca é um mito de origem portuguesa relacionado à Coca, figura que aparecia nas procissões da província do Minho, em Portugal.

claims.statement: Also in Minho, "cuca" is the popular name of a kind of pumpkin that used to be pierced with the outlines of eyes and mouth and had a lit candle placed inside.
claims.statement_id: Di Minho, "cuca" juga nama populer sejenis labu yang biasa dilubangi membentuk mata dan mulut, dengan lilin menyala di dalamnya.
claims.quote: Também no Minho, "cuca" é o nome popular de uma espécie de abóbora que costumava-se perfurar com contornos de olhos e boca, e dentro da qual era colocada uma vela acesa

claims.statement: Another possible origin is the "Farricoco", a character who accompanied the Passos procession in the Algarve, also in Portugal.
claims.statement_id: Asal lain yang mungkin adalah "Farricoco", tokoh yang menyertai prosesi Passos di Algarve, juga di Portugal.
claims.quote: Outra origem possível seria o “Farricoco”, personagem que acompanhava a procissão de Passos, no Algarve, também em Portugal.

claims.statement: There are also versions in which more than one cuca may exist, as a kind of subclass of the bicho-papão, as described in the book "O Saci" (1921) by Monteiro Lobato.
claims.statement_id: Ada pula versi yang mengenal lebih dari satu cuca, seolah subkelas bicho-papão, seperti dalam buku "O Saci" (1921) karya Monteiro Lobato.
claims.quote: como também existem versões em que pode se existir mais de uma cuca, como se fosse uma subclasse de bicho-papão, como é descrito no livro “O Saci” (1921), de Monteiro Lobato.

claims.statement: She is described as a witch who kidnaps children and can take the form of an old woman or of a witch with an alligator head.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan sebagai penyihir yang menculik anak-anak dan dapat berwujud perempuan tua atau penyihir berkepala aligator.
claims.quote: Elle est décrite comme une sorcière qui kidnappe les enfants et qui peut prendre la forme d'une vieille femme ou d'une sorcière à tête d'alligator.

claims.statement: This legend derives from that of the Coca (or Coco) of Iberian folklore, a tradition that was probably introduced into Brazil at the time of colonisation.
claims.statement_id: Legenda ini diturunkan dari legenda Coca (atau Coco) dalam cerita rakyat Iberia, tradisi yang diduga masuk ke Brasil pada masa kolonisasi.
claims.quote: Cette légende dérive de celle de la Coca (ou Coco) du folklore ibérique, une tradition qui a vraisemblablement été introduite au Brésil au moment de la colonisation.

claims.statement: According to some traditions, a new Cuca emerges from an egg every 1,000 years; the previous Cuca then turns into a bird with a sad song, while the new one takes up her role, causing more harm than the previous one.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sebagian tradisi, Cuca baru muncul dari sebuah telur setiap 1.000 tahun; Cuca sebelumnya berubah menjadi burung berkicau sedih, sedangkan yang baru menjalankan perannya dan menimbulkan lebih banyak kerugian.
claims.quote: Ainsi, selon certaines de ces traditions, une nouvelle Cuca émergerait d'un œuf tous les 1 000 ans. La précédente Cuca se transformerait alors en un oiseau au chant triste, tandis que la nouvelle remplirait son rôle, occasionnant plus de mal que la précédente.

claims.statement: In Monteiro Lobato's book "O Saci" (1921), the Cuca is described as a "horrible witch" with very fine hearing, "as old as time", living in a cave in the forest and sleeping only one night every seven years; it is the only work by the writer in which she appears.
claims.statement_id: Dalam buku "O Saci" (1921) karya Monteiro Lobato, Cuca digambarkan sebagai "penyihir mengerikan" berpendengaran sangat tajam, "setua waktu", tinggal di gua di hutan dan hanya tidur satu malam setiap tujuh tahun; itu satu-satunya karya Lobato tempat ia muncul.
claims.quote: Au Brésil, la Cuca a été popularisée par le livre "O Saci" (1921), de Monteiro Lobato. C'est par ailleurs la seule œuvre de l'écrivain dans laquelle elle apparaît. Elle y est décrite comme une "horrible sorcière", dotée d'une ouïe très fine, "vieille comme le temps", vivant dans une grotte dans la forêt et ne dormant qu'une nuit tous les sept ans.

claims.statement: According to the book, the Cuca has "a face like an alligator and claws on her fingers like hawks".
claims.statement_id: Menurut buku itu, Cuca memiliki "wajah seperti aligator dan cakar di jari-jarinya seperti elang".
claims.quote: Selon le livre, la Cuca a « un visage comme un alligator et des griffes sur ses doigts comme les faucons ».

claims.statement: In the two series adapted from Monteiro Lobato's work produced by Rede Globo, five different costumes were used for the Cuca.
claims.statement_id: Dalam dua serial adaptasi karya Monteiro Lobato yang diproduksi Rede Globo, lima kostum berbeda dipakai untuk Cuca.
claims.quote: Dans les deux séries adaptatées de l'œuvre de Monteiro Lobato produites par Rede Globo, cinq costumes différents ont été utilisés pour la Cuca.

claims.statement: Legend has it ("Reza a lenda") that the bruxa (witch) Cuca dorme (sleeps) uma vez a cada sete anos (once every seven years).
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda ("Reza a lenda"), bruxa (penyihir) Cuca dorme (tidur) uma vez a cada sete anos (sekali setiap tujuh tahun).
claims.quote: Reza a lenda que a bruxa Cuca dorme uma vez a cada sete anos.

claims.statement: The Cuyancúa is a Salvadoran legend recounted mainly in Izalco, Sonsonate.
claims.statement_id: Cuyancúa adalah legenda El Salvador yang utamanya dituturkan di kotamadya Izalco, Sonsonate.
claims.quote: La cuyancúa o Cuyancuat, es una leyenda salvadoreña narrada principalmente en el municipio de Izalco, en el departamento de Sonsonate.

claims.statement: It is a mythological entity that holds dominion over river waters and rain.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini memiliki kekuasaan atas air sungai dan hujan.
claims.quote: es también un ser mitológico que tiene cierto dominio sobre las aguas de los ríos y la lluvia.

claims.statement: A sinister screech followed by strong subterranean turbulence was attributed to the Cuyancúa.
claims.statement_id: Terdengar lengkingan mengerikan disertai getaran kuat di bawah tanah yang dikaitkan dengan Cuyancúa.
claims.quote: se escuchaba una especie de graznido o chillido tenebroso, seguido de fuertes turbulencias bajo la tierra, este fenómeno se le atribuía a la Cuyancúa

claims.statement: According to oral tradition, it is a large mythical being of strange appearance, the lower half of its body shaped like a snake and the upper half like a pig.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tradisi lisan, ia makhluk mitis berukuran besar dan berpenampilan aneh; separuh bawah tubuhnya berbentuk ular dan separuh atasnya berbentuk babi.
claims.quote: Según la tradición oral, es un ser mítico de gran tamaño y apariencia extraña, la mitad inferior de su cuerpo tiene forma de serpiente y la mitad superior tiene forma de cerdo.

claims.statement: This being announces the coming of rain, and according to testimonies not just one cuyancúa appears but sometimes several do so in a group.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini mengumumkan datangnya hujan, dan menurut kesaksian, yang muncul tidak hanya satu cuyancúa tetapi kadang berkelompok.
claims.quote: Este ser anuncia la llegada de la lluvia y según los testimonios, no solo aparece una cuyancúa sino a veces lo hacen en grupo.

claims.statement: This sound was heard mainly around rivers and streams, where the Cuyancúa crawled looking for food.
claims.statement_id: Bunyi itu terutama terdengar di sekitar sungai dan anak sungai, tempat Cuyancúa merayap mencari makanan.
claims.quote: Este sonido se escuchaba principalmente en los alrededores de los ríos y quebradas, donde la Cuyancúa se arrastraba buscando alimento.

claims.statement: People who stayed up late claim to have seen it face to face; they say the shock of seeing the Cuyancúa can cause fainting and loss of speech for a time.
claims.statement_id: Orang yang begadang mengaku pernah melihatnya langsung; dikatakan melihat Cuyancúa dapat menyebabkan pingsan dan kehilangan suara untuk sementara.
claims.quote: Personas que trasnochaban aseguran haberla visto de frente, comentan que el impacto de ver a la Cuyancúa puede provocar desmayos y la pérdida del habla por algún tiempo.

claims.statement: It is said that on seeing or hearing the Cuyancúa the best course is to adopt a peaceful attitude, close one's eyes and commend oneself to God.
claims.statement_id: Konon bila melihat atau mendengar Cuyancúa, sebaiknya bersikap tenang, memejamkan mata, dan menyerahkan diri kepada Tuhan.
claims.quote: Se dice que al ver o escuchar a la Cuyancúa lo mejor es adoptar una actitud pacífica, cerrar los ojos y encomendarse a Dios.

claims.statement: The legend also says that where the Cuyancúa digs to lie down, springs form from which clean, fresh water gushes.
claims.statement_id: Legenda juga mengisahkan bahwa di tempat Cuyancúa menggali untuk berbaring terbentuk mata air yang memancarkan air bersih dan segar.
claims.quote: la leyenda narra también, que donde la Cuyancúa escarba para echarse se forman nacimientos donde brota un agua limpia y fresca

claims.statement: For anyone daring to look for it, the Cuyancúa is said to still hide in the surroundings of the Atecozol spa.
claims.statement_id: Bagi yang berani mencarinya, konon Cuyancúa masih bersembunyi di sekitar balneario (pemandian) Atecozol.
claims.quote: Para quien se anime a buscarla, se dice que la Cuyancúa aún se esconde en los alrededores del balneario Atecozol.

claims.statement: At the Atecozol Tourist Centre in Sonsonate a stone image of this mythical being can be found.
claims.statement_id: Di Pusat Wisata Atecozol di Sonsonate terdapat patung batu makhluk mitis ini.
claims.quote: En el Centro Turístico Atecozol, en Sonsonate, se puede encontrar una imagen en piedra de este ser mítico.

claims.statement: According to this journal article, the Cuyancúa is one of the mythological beings that announce the season of the earth's "pregnancy" and is, for the people of Izalco, their cultural heritage, also associated with the natural.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel jurnal ini, Cuyancúa adalah salah satu makhluk mitologis yang mengumumkan musim "kehamilan bumi" dan bagi warga Izalco merupakan warisan budaya mereka, yang juga terkait dengan alam.
claims.quote: uno de los seres mitológicos que anuncian la época de preñez de la tierra es la Cuyancúa, que es para los izalqueños su patrimonio cultural, asociado también al natural

claims.statement: A respondent quoted in the article recounts that when it was raining very hard and the Cuyancúa's shriek was heard, it meant a storm was coming.
claims.statement_id: Seorang narasumber dalam artikel itu mengisahkan bahwa ketika hujan sangat deras dan terdengar jeritan Cuyancúa, itu pertanda akan datang badai.
claims.quote: cuando estaba lloviendo bastante fuerte y se escuchaba el chillido de la Cuyancúa, que era porque iba a ver temporal.

claims.statement: The article stresses that the Cuyancúa is the nahual of the Izalcos within their Nahua-Pipil mythology.
claims.statement_id: Artikel itu menegaskan bahwa Cuyancúa adalah nahual orang Izalco dalam mitologi Nahua-Pipil mereka.
claims.quote: Es importante recalcar que la Cuyancúa es el nahual de los Izalcos, dentro de su mitología nahua pipil

claims.statement: According to the article, the Cuyancúa and the Xipetotec both announce the start of the dry season, when food is scarcer, and the arrival of the rainy season that signals the earth's "pregnancy" and hence abundant food.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel itu, Cuyancúa dan Xipetotec sama-sama mengumumkan awal musim kering, ketika makanan lebih langka, dan datangnya musim hujan yang menandakan "kehamilan bumi" sehingga makanan berlimpah.
claims.quote: Ambos la Cuyancúa y el Xipetotec, son los que anuncian el inicio de la época seca, en donde el alimento es más escaso, y la llegada del invierno que anuncia la preñez de la tierra, y por ende la abundancia del alimento.

claims.statement: The creature is also known as Sister Lakes Sasquatch, similar to descriptions of Bigfoot.
claims.statement_id: Dewey Lake Monster dikenal juga sebagai Sister Lakes Sasquatch dan dideskripsikan mirip Bigfoot.
claims.quote: The Dewey Lake Monster, also known as the Sister Lakes Sasquatch, is purported to be an ape-like cryptid, similar to descriptions of Bigfoot

claims.statement: Described as covered in hair, 10 feet tall, 500 pounds, with glowing eyes.
claims.statement_id: Dideskripsikan berbulu lebat, tinggi sekitar 10 kaki, berbobot 500 pon, dan memiliki mata bersinar.
claims.quote: The creature was described as covered in hair, approximately 10 feet (3 m) tall, 500 pounds (230 kilograms), and had glowing eyes.

claims.statement: Attracted national attention in June 1964 following sightings by local residents.
claims.statement_id: Mendapat perhatian nasional pada Juni 1964 setelah warga melaporkan penampakan makhluk besar berbulu.
claims.quote: In June 1964, the story gained national attention after local residents reported seeing a large, hairy creature with glowing eyes.

claims.statement: It was allegedly sighted in the summer of 1964 near Dewey Lake and Sister Lakes in Dowagiac.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini konon terlihat pada musim panas 1964 di dekat Dewey Lake dan Sister Lakes di Dowagiac.
claims.quote: that was allegedly sighted in the summer of 1964 near Dewey Lake and Sister Lakes in Dowagiac.

claims.statement: Police searched the area of the sightings and found nothing, but the reports caused thrill-seekers and monster hunters to besiege the community that summer.
claims.statement_id: Polisi menyisir daerah penampakan dan tidak menemukan apa pun, tetapi laporan itu membuat para pencari sensasi dan pemburu monster mengepung komunitas tersebut pada musim panas itu.
claims.quote: Police searched the area of the alleged sightings and found nothing. Nevertheless, the reports caused curious thrill-seekers and monster hunters to besiege the community that summer.

claims.statement: Local businesspeople profited from the excitement, selling "monster getaway gas", "monster burgers" and "monster hunting kits" that held a net, a flashlight, a squirt gun, a mallet and a stake.
claims.statement_id: Pengusaha setempat memanfaatkan peristiwa itu dengan menjual "monster getaway gas", "monster burgers", dan "monster hunting kits" berisi jaring, senter, pistol air, palu, dan pasak.
claims.quote: Local entrepreneurs capitalized on the event by selling "monster getaway gas", "monster burgers", and "monster hunting kits" — with a net, flashlight, squirt gun, a mallet, and a stake.

claims.statement: Newspapers in Chicago began dubbing Sister Lakes "Monster Town USA" and caricaturing small-town stereotypes.
claims.statement_id: Surat kabar di Chicago mulai menjuluki Sister Lakes "Monster Town USA" dan sekaligus mengkarikaturkan stereotip kota kecil.
claims.quote: Newspapers in Chicago began dubbing Sister Lakes "Monster Town USA", as well as caricaturing small town stereotypes.

claims.statement: Several zoologists suggested people may have misidentified a bear or gorilla, while Cass County Sheriff Robert Dool and conservation officer William Rowe dismissed speculation of a monster.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa ahli zoologi menduga orang keliru mengenali beruang atau gorila, sedangkan Sheriff Cass County Robert Dool dan petugas konservasi William Rowe menepis dugaan adanya monster.
claims.quote: Several zoologists suggested that people may have misidentified a bear or gorilla. Cass County Sheriff Robert Dool and conservation officer William Rowe dismissed speculations of a monster.

claims.statement: Within a week the hysteria diminished, and the South Bend Tribune reported that "nobody seems frightened anymore".
claims.statement_id: Dalam seminggu kehebohan mereda, dan South Bend Tribune melaporkan bahwa "nobody seems frightened anymore".
claims.quote: Within a week, the hysteria diminished, and the South Bend Tribune reported that "nobody seems frightened anymore".

claims.statement: In a 1983 retrospective, the South Bend Tribune suggested that the monster was imagined by intoxicated strawberry pickers.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tinjauan tahun 1983, South Bend Tribune menyatakan bahwa monster itu dibayangkan oleh para pemetik stroberi yang mabuk.
claims.quote: In a 1983 retrospective, the South Bend Tribune suggested that the monster was imagined by intoxicated strawberry pickers.

claims.statement: Dowagiac gained national attention in June 1964 after police began investigating multiple reports of what became known as the Dewey Lake Monster.
claims.statement_id: Dowagiac menarik perhatian nasional pada Juni 1964 setelah polisi mulai menyelidiki banyak laporan tentang apa yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Dewey Lake Monster.
claims.quote: Dowagiac gained national attention in June 1964 after police began investigating multiple reports of what became known as the Dewey Lake Monster.

claims.statement: The Dungarvon Whooper is a ghost story in a song by Michael Whelan about an alleged murder in New Brunswick, Canada.
claims.statement_id: Dungarvon Whooper adalah kisah hantu dalam lagu gubahan Michael Whelan tentang pembunuhan di sungai Dungarvon River, New Brunswick, Canada.
claims.quote: The Dungarvon Whooper (pronounced "hooper") is a ghost story told in a song composed by Michael Whelan, about the alleged murder along the Dungarvon River in central New Brunswick, Canada

claims.statement: The story revolves around a young cook working in a New Brunswick lumber camp along the river.
claims.statement_id: Cerita ini berpusat pada seorang juru masak muda di kamp penebang kayu New Brunswick di sepanjang Dungarvon river.
claims.quote: The story revolves around a young cook working in a New Brunswick lumber camp, along Dungarvon river.

claims.statement: It is described as an invisible ghost, or sometimes as a wildcat or puma-like creature.
claims.statement_id: Biasanya berwujud hantu tak terlihat, tetapi kadang dikatakan menyerupai kucing liar atau puma.
claims.quote: The Dungarvon Whooper's physical description is usually that of an invisible ghost, but it is also sometimes said to resemble a wildcat or puma-like creature

claims.statement: While the lumberjacks are away, the cook is left alone with the camp boss, who decides to murder and rob him.
claims.statement_id: Saat para penebang kayu pergi, sang juru masak ditinggal berdua dengan bos kamp, yang memutuskan membunuh dan merampoknya.
claims.quote: While the lumberjacks are out, the cook is left alone with the boss of the camp, who decides to murder and rob the young cook.

claims.statement: That night a terrible "whooping" sound keeps the group awake, presumably the ghost of Ryan crying out against the crime he suffered; the men flee the camp, and finally a priest arrives and his prayers bring peace to the haunting spirit.
claims.statement_id: Malam itu suara "whooping" yang mengerikan membuat rombongan tak bisa tidur, diduga hantu Ryan yang menjerit menentang kejahatan yang menimpanya; para lelaki melarikan diri, dan akhirnya seorang pastor datang dan doanya menenangkan arwah itu.
claims.quote: However, a terrible "whooping" sound keeps the group from falling asleep that night, presumably the ghost of Ryan crying out against the crime of which he was the victim. Scared, the men flee the camp. Finally a priest arrives, and his prayers bring peace to the haunting spirit of the dead man

claims.statement: In most versions the cook is regarded as an Irishman and later tellings give him the name Ryan or Ryan Garvon.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kebanyakan versi, sang juru masak dianggap orang Irlandia, dan penuturan belakangan memberinya nama Ryan atau Ryan Garvon.
claims.quote: In most versions, the cook is regarded to be an Irishman, and is assigned the name of Ryan or Ryan Garvon by later tellings of the tale.

claims.statement: The murder and haunting are purported to have taken place around 1850–1875, a period of mass migration from Ireland to Canada following the Great Famine.
claims.statement_id: Pembunuhan dan penghantuan itu konon terjadi sekitar 1850–1875, masa migrasi besar-besaran dari Irlandia ke Kanada setelah Kelaparan Besar.
claims.quote: The murder and haunting is purported to have taken place around 1850–1875, a period of mass migration from Ireland to Canada, following the Great Famine.

claims.statement: It has been commented that the "whooping" call heard might actually have come from a screech owl or a panther.
claims.statement_id: Ada komentar bahwa panggilan "whooping" itu mungkin sebenarnya berasal dari burung hantu screech owl atau panther.
claims.quote: It has been commented that the "whooping" call heard might have actually come from a screech owl or a panther.

claims.statement: While the exact origin of the story is unknown, the best-known version comes from a song published in a local newspaper by Michael Whelan in 1912.
claims.statement_id: Asal-usul pastinya tidak diketahui, tetapi versi paling terkenal berasal dari lagu karya Michael Whelan yang dimuat di surat kabar lokal pada 1912.
claims.quote: While the exact origin of the story is unknown, the best-known version comes from a song published in a local newspaper by Michael Whelan in 1912.

claims.statement: Maine storyteller Leroy Dudley tells a version in which the Dungarvon Whooper contests the Native American spirit Pamola for hegemony over Katahdin, the tallest mountain in Maine.
claims.statement_id: Penutur cerita dari Maine, Leroy Dudley, menuturkan versi tempat Dungarvon Whooper memperebutkan kekuasaan atas Katahdin, gunung tertinggi di negara bagian Maine, dengan roh pribumi Amerika Pamola.
claims.quote: Leroy Dudley, a storyteller from Maine (which borders New Brunswick) tells a version where the Dungarvon Whooper contests the Native American spirit Pamola over hegemony of the Katahdin, the tallest mountain in the state of Maine.

claims.statement: The first issue of the Dark Horse comic series "Blue Book: 1947" includes a back-up segment called "True Weird" that features an adaptation of the Dungarvon Whooper.
claims.statement_id: Edisi pertama seri komik Dark Horse "Blue Book: 1947" memuat segmen tambahan "True Weird" yang menampilkan adaptasi Dungarvon Whooper.
claims.quote: The first issue of the Dark Horse comic series, "Blue Book: 1947", includes a back-up segment called "True Weird", which features an adaptation of the Dungarvon Whooper.

claims.statement: The story concerns an alleged murder along the Dungarvon River in central New Brunswick, Canada, in the mid to late 19th century.
claims.statement_id: Kisah ini tentang dugaan pembunuhan di tepi Sungai Dungarvon di tengah New Brunswick, Kanada, pada pertengahan hingga akhir abad ke-19.
claims.quote: about the alleged murder along the Dungarvon River in central New Brunswick, Canada, in the mid to late 19th century.

claims.statement: In this retelling, an Irish lumberjack named Ryan coveted the cook's money and concocted a plan to get it.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penceritaan ulang ini, seorang penebang kayu Irlandia bernama Ryan mengincar uang sang juru masak dan menyusun rencana untuk mendapatkannya.
claims.quote: Now an Irish lumberjack named Ryan coveted the cook's money and concocted a plan to get it.

claims.statement: Deep in the woods, Ryan turned his rifle on the cook and shot him dead.
claims.statement_id: Di dalam hutan yang dalam, Ryan mengarahkan senapannya ke sang juru masak dan menembaknya mati.
claims.quote: When they were deep in the woods, Ryan turned his rifle on the cook and shot him dead.

claims.statement: At dusk every evening for several weeks the cook's ghost shrieked out his terror and rage over his murder; all activity in the camp stopped at the first sound of the "Dungarvon Whooper", as the ghost came to be called.
claims.statement_id: Setiap senja selama beberapa minggu, hantu sang juru masak menjerit karena ketakutan dan amarah atas pembunuhannya; kegiatan di kamp berhenti begitu terdengar bunyi "Dungarvon Whooper", nama yang kemudian diberikan kepada hantu itu.
claims.quote: At dusk every evening for several weeks, the ghost of the cook shrieked out his terror and rage over his murder. All action in the logging camp ceased at the first sound of the "Dungarvon Whooper," as the ghost came to be called

claims.statement: In this retelling the priest prayed over the area and tried to exorcise the spirit with bell, book and candle, but the ghost was too strong and he left in defeat.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penceritaan ulang ini, sang pastor berdoa di daerah itu dan mencoba mengusir arwah dengan lonceng, kitab, dan lilin, tetapi hantu itu terlalu kuat dan ia pergi dalam kekalahan.
claims.quote: The holy man prayed over the area and tried to exorcise the spirit with bell, book, and candle, but the ghost was too strong for him, and he left in defeat.

claims.statement: The ewiger Jäger is a local variant of the ghostly wild huntsman.
claims.statement_id: Ewiger Jäger adalah varian lokal dari hantu pemburu liar dalam cerita rakyat Jerman.
claims.quote: The ewiger Jäger (eternal hunter; der ewige Jäger; German: ... is a local variant of the ghostly wild huntsman

claims.statement: Count Eberhard of Württemberg encountered the ewiger Jäger while hunting in the woods.
claims.statement_id: Count Eberhard dari Württemberg pernah berjumpa dengan Ewiger Jäger ketika sedang berburu di hutan.
claims.quote: Count Eberhard of Württemberg encountered the ewiger Jäger while hunting in the woods.

claims.statement: Der Ewich Yeeger is a ghostly entity dwelling on the Blobarrickgrat ridge in Pennsilfaani.
claims.statement_id: Der Ewich Yeeger adalah makhluk gaib yang mendiami pegunungan Blobarrickgrat di Pennsilfaani.
claims.quote: Der Ewich Yeeger iss en geischtiches Wese, wu uff em Blobarrickgrat im Pennsilfaani wuhnt.

claims.statement: The ewiger Jäger is found in German, Belgian and American folklore.
claims.statement_id: Ewiger Jäger ditemukan dalam cerita rakyat Jerman, Belgia, dan Amerika.
claims.quote: found in German, Belgian, and American folklore.

claims.statement: Ludwig Bechstein told the same legend with extra detail: according to him the ewiger Jäger appears as a gnarled little man dressed in green.
claims.statement_id: Ludwig Bechstein menceritakan legenda yang sama dengan detail tambahan: menurutnya ewiger Jäger tampil sebagai lelaki kecil berbuku-buku yang berpakaian hijau.
claims.quote: Ludwig Bechstein told the same legend and gave additional detail. According to him, the ewiger Jäger appears as a gnarled little man dressed in green.

claims.statement: In Bechstein's version he was punished with an eternal hunt for hunting on a Sunday, breaking Sunday rest.
claims.statement_id: Menurut versi Bechstein, ia dihukum berburu abadi karena berburu pada hari Minggu dan melanggar istirahat hari Minggu.
claims.quote: He was punished with eternal hunt for going for a hunt on a Sunday, breaking Sunday rest.

claims.statement: Other names for the eternal hunter are Ruprecht, Hans and Riesenjäger.
claims.statement_id: Nama lain bagi pemburu abadi ini adalah Ruprecht, Hans, dan Riesenjäger.
claims.quote: Other names for the eternal hunter are Ruprecht, Hans, and Riesenjäger.

claims.statement: Bechstein also told a legend from Belgium about the eternal hunter: near Wijnendale Castle in Flanders lived a pious, hardworking farmer with an only son.
claims.statement_id: Bechstein juga menceritakan legenda dari Belgia tentang pemburu abadi: di dekat Kastil Wijnendale di Flanders tinggal seorang petani saleh dan pekerja keras yang memiliki satu putra.
claims.quote: Bechstein also told a legend from Belgium about the eternal hunter. Near Wijnendale Castle in Flanders, there dwelled a pious and hardworking farmer who had an only son.

claims.statement: The cursed son never returned home and was heard in the woods shouting "Jakko! Jakko! Jakko!", screeching like a bird of prey or barking like a dog, doomed to go on until Judgement Day or longer.
claims.statement_id: Putra yang dikutuk itu tak pernah pulang dan terdengar di hutan berteriak "Jakko! Jakko! Jakko!", menjerit seperti burung pemangsa atau menggonggong seperti anjing, ditakdirkan terus hingga Hari Penghakiman atau lebih lama.
claims.quote: Afterward, the cursed son never returned home and was heard in the woods shouting "Jakko! Jakko! Jakko!", screeching like a bird of prey or barking like a dog, doomed to continue until Judgement Day or longer.

claims.statement: In the United States the ewiger Jäger was introduced by German immigrants in Pennsylvania who were later called Pennsylvania Dutch.
claims.statement_id: Di Amerika Serikat, ewiger Jäger dibawa oleh para imigran Jerman di Pennsylvania yang kemudian disebut Pennsylvania Dutch.
claims.quote: In the United States, the ewiger Jäger was introduced by German immigrants in Pennsylvania who later were called Pennsylvania Dutch.

claims.statement: In Pine Grove, Blue Mountain is believed to be haunted by Dar Ewich Jaejer or Ewige Jaeger; when a phantom pack of hounds is heard on a quiet fall hunting-season night, people look to the sky and say the eternal hunter is riding.
claims.statement_id: Di Pine Grove, Blue Mountain dipercaya dihantui Dar Ewich Jaejer atau Ewige Jaeger; ketika segerombolan anjing hantu terdengar pada malam sunyi musim berburu musim gugur, orang menengok ke langit dan berkata bahwa pemburu abadi sedang berkuda.
claims.quote: In Pine Grove, Blue Mountain is believed to be haunted by Dar Ewich Jaejer or Ewige Jaeger. When a phantom pack of hounds is heard on a quiet night in the fall hunting season, people look to the sky and say that the eternal hunter is riding.

claims.statement: He is said to have been a fox hunter who cursed and swore an oath to catch a certain fox, even if he had to chase it into eternity.
claims.statement_id: Konon ia dulunya pemburu rubah yang mengumpat dan bersumpah menangkap seekor rubah tertentu, meski harus mengejarnya sampai keabadian.
claims.quote: He is said to have been a fox hunter who cursed and swore an oath to catch a certain fox, even if he had to chase it into eternity.

claims.statement: The Canada goose is called Awicher Yager (eternal hunter) because of its sounds: a flock travelling at night can sound like a pack of dogs baying in the sky.
claims.statement_id: Angsa Kanada disebut Awicher Yager (pemburu abadi) karena suaranya: kawanan yang terbang pada malam hari dapat terdengar seperti segerombolan anjing yang menyalak di langit.
claims.quote: The Canada goose is called Awicher Yager (i.e., eternal hunter) because of its sounds: a flock traveling at night can sound like a pack of dogs baying in the sky.

claims.statement: In Blue Mountain (Blobarrick in Pennsylvania German), the Ewicher Yeeger became known when, after Lynn Township was founded in 1732, a severe drought with crop failure and the disappearance of all game animals struck the area the settlers called Allemaengel.
claims.statement_id: Di Blue Mountain (Blobarrick dalam bahasa Jerman Pennsylvania), Ewicher Yeeger menjadi dikenal ketika setelah berdirinya Lynn Township pada 1732, di daerah yang oleh para pemukim disebut Allemaengel, terjadi kekeringan parah disertai gagal panen dan lenyapnya semua hewan buruan.
claims.quote: In Blue Mountain (Pennsylvania German Blobarrick), the Ewicher Yeeger became known when, after the foundation of Lynn Township in 1732, in the area called Allemaengel (all deficiencies) by Pennsylvania German settlers, there was a severe drought accompanied by crop failure and the disappearance of all game animals.

claims.statement: The barking and howling pack of the Ewicher Yeeger can be heard while the wild huntsman assures people that Blue Mountain remains bountiful.
claims.statement_id: Gonggongan dan lolongan kawanan Ewicher Yeeger dapat terdengar, sementara sang pemburu liar meyakinkan orang bahwa Blue Mountain tetap melimpah.
claims.quote: The barking and howling pack of Ewicher Yeeger can be heard while the wild huntsman assures people that Blue Mountain remains bountiful.

claims.statement: The eternal hunter is said to hunt on South Mountain at night, heard calling his pack of dogs; those who meet him at night are either torn to bits by his dogs or spirited away, never to be seen again.
claims.statement_id: Pemburu abadi konon berburu di South Mountain pada malam hari dan terdengar memanggil gerombolan anjingnya; yang bertemu dengannya malam itu akan dicabik anjingnya atau dibawa pergi dan tak pernah terlihat lagi.
claims.quote: The eternal hunter is said to hunt on South Mountain at night, where he can be heard calling for his pack of dogs. Those encountering him at night will either be torn to bits by his dogs or spirited away, never to be seen again.

claims.statement: In Lebanon County der Eewich Yeager is associated with the Cornwall Iron Furnace, and his story is told by George Henry Boker in the poem "The Legend of the Hounds"; he is said to have been the furnace's cruel ironmaster in life.
claims.statement_id: Di Lebanon County, der Eewich Yeager dikaitkan dengan Cornwall Iron Furnace dan kisahnya dituturkan George Henry Boker dalam puisi "The Legend of the Hounds"; konon semasa hidup ia adalah pemilik tungku besi yang kejam.
claims.quote: In Lebanon County, der Eewich Yeager is associated with the Cornwall Iron Furnace, and his story is told by George Henry Boker in the poem "The Legend of the Hounds". Der Eewich Yeager is said to have been the cruel ironmaster of the furnace in life.

claims.statement: There are two distinct traditions about the Ewicher Yeeger: the first, widespread, holds that he is an airy ghost; the second holds that he must fulfil a vow.
claims.statement_id: Ada dua tradisi yang jelas tentang Ewicher Yeeger: yang pertama, yang tersebar luas, menyatakan ia hantu udara; yang kedua menyatakan ia harus memenuhi sebuah janji.
claims.quote: Es gebt zwee deitliche Iwwerlieferinge um Ewicher Yeeger. Die aerscht, wu weitverbreit iss, haldet, as er en lufdicher Geischt iss. Zwetti haldet, as er en Verschpreche erfille muss.

claims.statement: All the stories say that Der Ewich Yeeger and his pack of dogs can be heard; although he is a rescuer, he is also dangerous.
claims.statement_id: Semua cerita mengatakan Der Ewich Yeeger dan kawanan anjingnya dapat terdengar; walau ia penyelamat, ia juga berbahaya.
claims.quote: Alle Gschichte verzehle, as mer nooch Der Ewich Yeeger un sei Hundpack heere kann. Ebwohl Der Ewich Yeeger en Redder iss, iss er aa gfaehrlich.

claims.statement: According to the Grimms' Deutsche Sagen, Count Eberhard of Württemberg rode alone into the green forest one day to hunt; suddenly he heard a strong roaring and noise as if a huntsman were passing.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Deutsche Sagen Grimm, Graf Eberhard dari Württemberg suatu hari berkuda sendirian ke hutan hijau untuk berburu; tiba-tiba ia mendengar deru dan keributan keras, seakan seorang pemburu lewat.
claims.quote: Graf Eberhard von Würtenberg ritt eines Tages allein in den grünen Wald aus und wollte zu seiner Kurzweil jagen. Plötzlich hörte er ein starkes Brausen und Lärmen, wie wenn ein Weidmann vorüber käme

claims.statement: The ghost says he so loved hunting that he begged God to let him hunt until Judgement Day; his wish was granted, and for four and a half centuries he has chased the same stag.
claims.statement_id: Sang hantu berkata ia begitu gemar berburu hingga memohon kepada Tuhan agar boleh berburu sampai hari kiamat; permintaannya dikabulkan, dan sudah empat setengah abad ia mengejar rusa jantan yang sama.
claims.quote: An dem Jagen hatte ich aber solche Lust, daß ich Gott anflehte, er möge mich jagen lassen, bis zu dem jüngsten Tag. Mein Wunsch wurde leider erhört und schon fünfthalb hundert Jahre jage ich an einem und demselben Hirsch.

claims.statement: When the ghost revealed his face, it was barely fist-sized, withered like a turnip and wrinkled like a sponge.
claims.statement_id: Ketika sang hantu menampakkan wajahnya, wajah itu hampir sebesar kepalan tangan, kering seperti lobak dan berkerut seperti spons.
claims.quote: Da entblößte sich der Geist, sein Antlitz war kaum faustgroß, verdorrt, wie eine Rübe und gerunzelt, als ein Schwamm.

claims.statement: The Galipote, also called Zángano or Lugarú, is a legendary figure from San Juan in the Dominican Republic.
claims.statement_id: Galipote atau Zángano atau Lugarú adalah tokoh legendaris asal San Juan, Republik Dominika.
claims.quote: El Galipote, también llamado Zángano o Lugarú, es un personaje legendario supuestamente de República Dominicana, oriundo de San Juan

claims.statement: It is characterized by the ability to transform into diverse animals and inanimate objects.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini mampu berubah bentuk menjadi beraneka satwa dan benda tak hidup.
claims.quote: Se trataba de un ser mítico caracterizado por la habilidad de transformarse en distintos animales y objetos inanimados

claims.statement: It possesses atrocious physical strength and immunity against firearms.
claims.statement_id: Ia memiliki kekuatan sangat besar dan kebal terhadap tembakan senjata api.
claims.quote: además de gozar de una fuerza atroz e inmunidad contra las armas de fuego.

claims.statement: Originally from San Juan, it probably dates back to between the 17th and 18th centuries.
claims.statement_id: Berasal dari San Juan, asal-usulnya mungkin berasal dari antara abad ke-17 dan ke-18.
claims.quote: oriundo de San Juan, que probablemente remonta sus orígenes entre los siglos XVII y XVIII.

claims.statement: It was said to feed on the blood of innocent children, sucked at night, with which it obtained eternal life.
claims.statement_id: Konon ia biasa makan darah anak-anak tak berdosa yang dihisapnya pada malam hari, dan dengannya memperoleh hidup abadi.
claims.quote: Se decía que solía alimentarse de la sangre de niños inocentes (que succionaba durante las noches), con la que obtenía la vida eterna

claims.statement: The origin of its power is not entirely clear, but most agree it came from a pact with the devil.
claims.statement_id: Asal kekuatannya tidak sepenuhnya jelas, tetapi kebanyakan sepakat bahwa itu berasal dari perjanjian dengan setan.
claims.quote: El origen de su poder no está del todo claro, sin embargo, la mayoría coincide en que se debía a un pacto con el diablo

claims.statement: There is a belief in a galipote able to turn only into a dog, called lugaru, a term that seems to come from French loup-garou, the legendary werewolf.
claims.statement_id: Ada kepercayaan tentang galipote yang hanya dapat berubah menjadi anjing, disebut lugaru, istilah yang tampaknya berasal dari bahasa Prancis loup-garou untuk manusia serigala.
claims.quote: Existe la creencia de un galipote capaz de convertirse exclusivamente en perro, conocido como lugaru (término que parece provenir del francés loup-garou, denominación empleada para el legendario hombre lobo o licántropo).

claims.statement: Another subspecies called zángano or zancú is also mentioned, able to take strides as long as the distance between one river and the next and even to become invisible.
claims.statement_id: Disebut pula subspesies lain bernama zángano atau zancú, yang mampu melangkah sejauh jarak antara satu sungai dan sungai lain, bahkan bisa menjadi tak terlihat.
claims.quote: También se habla de otra subespecie conocida como zángano o zancú, caracterizada por la habilidad de andar dando zancadas (tan largas como la distancia entre un río y otro), capaces incluso de volverse invisibles.

claims.statement: According to popular belief, the galipote was vulnerable only to a stake from a tree known as palo de cruz, which had to be cut specifically on Good Friday.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan populer, galipote hanya rentan terhadap pasak dari pohon yang disebut palo de cruz, yang harus ditebang khusus pada Jumat Agung.
claims.quote: Según la creencia popular, el galipote solamente era vulnerable a una estaca proveniente de un árbol conocido como palo de cruz, que debía ser cortada específicamente el Viernes Santo.

claims.statement: According to the legend, they were cruel and violent beings who enjoyed leading night walkers astray and frightening the unwary.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, mereka makhluk kejam dan kasar yang gemar menyesatkan pejalan malam dan menakuti orang yang lengah.
claims.quote: Según cuenta la leyenda, se trataba de seres crueles y violentos que disfrutaban extraviando a los caminantes nocturnos y espantando a los desprevenidos.

claims.statement: The legend is so deeply rooted that in some areas walkers do not go out at night without protective amulets or reciting a spell.
claims.statement_id: Legenda ini begitu mengakar sehingga di beberapa daerah para pejalan tidak keluar malam tanpa jimat pelindung atau membaca mantra.
claims.quote: Tan arraigada está la leyenda que, en algunas zonas del país, los caminantes no salen por la noche sin amuletos protectores o recitar algún conjuro.

claims.statement: The Diccionario del español dominicano, as cited in this column, defines the galipote as a "person who, according to popular belief, has the ability to turn into an animal or a tree".
claims.statement_id: Menurut Diccionario del español dominicano yang dikutip kolom ini, galipote adalah "orang yang menurut kepercayaan populer berkemampuan berubah menjadi hewan atau pohon".
claims.quote: El galipote es una “Persona que, según la creencia popular, tiene la facultad de convertirse en animal o en árbol.

claims.statement: According to this column, the word entered Dominican Spanish through Haitian Creole galipòt, galpòt, gayipòt, a mythical animal resembling the lugarú (lougawou).
claims.statement_id: Menurut kolom ini, kata itu masuk ke bahasa Spanyol Dominika lewat Kreol Haiti galipòt, galpòt, gayipòt, hewan mitos yang menyerupai lugarú (lougawou).
claims.quote: La voz del título entró al español dominicano a través del criollo haitiano, galipòt, galpòt, gayipòt, que es un animal mítico que se asemeja al lugarú (lougawou).

claims.statement: The column says the French galipote closest to the Dominican one was known in the Centre-West and Auvergne of France, where the word named a monstrous animal wandering the fields at night.
claims.statement_id: Kolom ini menyebut galipote Prancis yang paling dekat dikenal di wilayah Centre-Ouest dan Auvergne, tempat kata itu menamai hewan monster yang berkeliaran malam hari di ladang.
claims.quote: El galipote francés más próximo del dominicano es el que se conoció en la región del Centro-Oeste y Auvernia en Francia, en la que se empleaba la voz para designar un animal monstruoso que deambulaba por la noche en los campos.

claims.statement: From there the word passed into Dominican Spanish to name a person who makes an evil pact and can turn into an animal or a tree.
claims.statement_id: Dari sana kata itu masuk ke bahasa Spanyol Dominika untuk menyebut orang yang membuat perjanjian jahat dan dapat berubah menjadi hewan atau pohon.
claims.quote: De aquí pasó al español dominicano para denominar a una persona que hace un pacto maléfico y puede convertirse en animal o árbol.

claims.statement: The column quotes a Dominican folklorist: among the most widespread rural beliefs is that some people can turn into animals and inanimate objects; those credited with this power are called "Galipotes o Dundunes".
claims.statement_id: Kolom ini mengutip folkloris Dominika: salah satu kepercayaan paling meluas di pedesaan adalah bahwa sebagian orang dapat berubah menjadi hewan dan benda mati; mereka yang dianggap berkuasa itu disebut "Galipotes o Dundunes".
claims.quote: Entre las creencias más extendidas en las zonas rurales dominicanas está la de atribuir a algunas personas la facultad de convertirse en animales y en objetos inanimados; los individuos a quienes se atribuye ese poder sobrenatural son llamados “Galipotes o Dundunes”.

claims.statement: The stories are heard in all regions of the country, more often in the South and near the Haitian border; few present Galipotes as interested in causing physical harm.
claims.statement_id: Cerita-cerita itu terdengar di seluruh negeri, lebih sering di Selatan dan dekat perbatasan Haiti; hanya sedikit yang menampilkan Galipote ingin mencelakai secara fisik.
claims.quote: Tales historias, que se escuchan en todas las regiones del país, son más frecuentes en el Sur y en las poblaciones cercanas a la frontera con Haití. Son pocas las historias en las que se presentan a los Galipotes como seres interesados en provocar daños físicos.

claims.statement: More numerous are stories in which they play mischievous tricks, such as blocking night walkers and confusing their way.
claims.statement_id: Lebih banyak cerita yang menampilkan Galipote berbuat jahil, seperti menghalangi pejalan malam dan mengacaukan jalan mereka.
claims.quote: Abundan más aquellas en las que aparecen haciendo bellaquerías, como impedir el paso a los caminantes nocturnos y confundirles los caminos.

claims.statement: It is also told that Galipotes, mostly men, turn into animals and inanimate objects that guard their property.
claims.statement_id: Diceritakan pula bahwa para Galipote, kebanyakan laki-laki, berubah menjadi hewan dan benda mati yang menjaga harta milik mereka.
